create_heun_discrete_scheduler: create a HeunDiscreteScheduler instance with custom beta schedule and inference steps for diffusion model sampling
set_timesteps_heun_scheduler: set the discrete timesteps and sigma schedule for a HeunDiscreteScheduler before running inference
step_heun_scheduler: call the step method on HeunDiscreteScheduler to compute the previous sample using Heun second-order denoising
build_betas_for_alpha_bar: build a beta schedule tensor using cosine, exponential, or laplace alpha bar transform for diffusion noise scheduling
add_noise_heun_scheduler: add noise to original samples at specified timesteps using the HeunDiscreteScheduler noise schedule
